statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail sits at 23%, in the upper watch band and below the 25% block threshold.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. NQ is holding near its overnight extreme on thin Globex turnover while cash NDX closed at its session low, so mean reversion is still demonstrably functioning. The concentrated event risk falls in the narrow 12:00-15:00Z window spanning US jobless claims, the cash open and ISM manufacturing.
headline: NQ grinds to a fresh overnight high on Micron's AI guidance while a 24-year-high 30-year yield keeps stress elevated
body: December E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures trade 30,929.25, up 230.50 points or 0.75% from the 30,698.75 settle, after printing a fresh overnight high at 30,953.75 and holding roughly 24 points beneath it. The whole Globex range spans 269.25 points, or 0.88%, on thin 44.72k turnover, and the move has cleared the 30,812.75 retracement-zone resistance while the 31,094.75 pivot that would mark genuine uptrend resumption remains about 165 points above. The catalyst is narrow and identifiable: Micron reported record fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of 54.23 billion dollars with non-GAAP earnings of 33.42 dollars a share and guided fiscal first-quarter revenue to 61.5 billion dollars against roughly 57 billion expected, lifting memory and semiconductor names in Asia, where the Nikkei 225 added about 1% to 67,425.65 on Advantest and Tokyo Electron. Micron itself closed only 0.37% higher in cash trade and the Kospi opened 0.3% lower, so the bid is neither broad nor uniform. Against that, the completed cash session argues reversion is intact: NDX closed at 30,408.50, the exact low of a 30,408.50 to 30,630.45 range, a full intraday fade, while the Dow fell 0.9% against a 0.2% Nasdaq Composite gain. Cross-assets are not aligned with an equity melt-up. The 2-year eased to 4.89% and the 10-year to 5.28% overnight, WTI fell 1.31% to 89.24 dollars and Brent 1.10% to 96.96 dollars as Middle East crude throughput recovered toward pre-war levels, and the VIX closed near 16.3. The dominant background risk is the long end: the 30-year reached 5.639%, its highest since 2002, in a sixth consecutive advance and the largest Treasury selloff since April 2025, with markets pricing October Fed hike odds in the mid-30% range even after August core PCE printed 0.2%. That equity-versus-bond divergence raises Stress and lowers directional conviction rather than establishing the persistent no-retracement path that Tail measures. One genuine amplifier is present, namely repeated extension to fresh overnight highs with price holding near the extreme, but it is unaccompanied by aligned cross-assets, broad participation or any observed failed retracement, and it rests on thin pre-event liquidity. Tail therefore firms one point to 23%, remaining inside the watch band.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hourly slots carry published Claude assessments. Tail sat at 15-16% through the European and early US hours of 30 September with the mode mixed, then stepped into the watch band at 20% from 12:00Z as the US data block and the bond selloff developed, peaking at 23% around 15:00-16:00Z. It held a 20-22% range through the US afternoon and the Asian session and firmed to 22% by 03:00Z as NQ began printing fresh overnight highs. Stress stayed in the high band throughout, between 65% and 72%, and Confidence held 85-88%.
outlookSummary: The mapped danger window is 12:00-15:00Z, covering initial jobless claims at 12:30Z with consensus 201k against 197k prior, the 13:30Z cash open, the final S&P Global manufacturing PMI at 13:45Z and ISM manufacturing at 14:00Z with consensus 54.8 against 54.6. Forecast Tail stays inside the watch band across all 24 slots, peaking at 24% across those event hours where Stress reaches 75%, then easing to 20-22% through the US afternoon and the Asian session. Treating the event stack as a checkpoint rather than an automatic block follows the observed pattern that release importance and surprise magnitude primarily raise Stress and whipsaw risk. Attention then rotates to the September employment report at 12:30Z on 2 October, which falls outside this forecast window and will publish normally because the funding lapse was averted. An upward Tail reassessment would require observed persistent one-way structure: shallow or failed retracements, repeated extension, NQ holding a session extreme into the US session, or cross-asset realignment behind the move.
